title: Static Clinging Wedge-Bill Tail-Braced Woodpecker
description: One newly authored complete stylised woodpecker-like bird in a fixed clinging pose on one short whole upright timber stem. Narrow upright torso flows into a short neck and small head with a long straight tapered wedge bill; two complete folded wings lie along the back, while two short bent legs meet full opposing-lobed thick feet against the stem and a long narrow stiff-looking tail reaches the lower stem. Whole new bird and stem construction together, not a recoloured hooked-bill standing parrot or a sloth branch with the animal swapped. The stem is a finite grounded pose support included in this single display model, not a separate tree asset. All visible forms are real closed thickness; no feather-strand, exact species, anatomical digit, climbing, pecking, balance, rig, animation, load or safety validation. One static model zero scenes.
